episodes.title: Prologue: Nana and NANA
episodes.summary: A chance encounter on a snowbound train brings together two girls who share one name — and a single, intertwined destiny.

episodes.title: Love? Friendship? Nana and Shoji
episodes.summary: Nana K. came from a small town, but she always had big city dreams… and a preoccupation with romance, sometimes found in not-so-great places.

episodes.title: Nana and Shoji, Love's Whereabouts
episodes.summary: Life in Tokyo beckons, but Nana K. isn't ready to heed its call — or so say her friends. But just as things look bleak, she runs into a familiar face.

episodes.title: Nana's Love, NANA's Dream
episodes.summary: The Black Stones' star is on the rise, but there's trouble in paradise when Ren receives an offer that leaves Nana O. feeling cold.

episodes.title: Ren's Dreams, NANA's Thoughts
episodes.summary: Ren's dedication to Trapnest is obvious to Nana O. It's also obvious she has some decisions to make and dreams of her own to chase.

episodes.title: Snowing in Tokyo! Nana and NANA
episodes.summary: Destiny is just a train ride away, waiting for both Nanas in Tokyo.

episodes.title: Yasu Appears! Room No. 707
episodes.summary: Another chance encounter leads to an unexpected living arrangement, but Nana K.'s friends are skeptical. Hopefully everyone can learn to get along…

episodes.title: Strawberry Grass and Lotus Flower
episodes.summary: The Nanas get settled, but the same-name thing is getting tough to navigate. Luckily Nana O. knows the perfect nickname for Nana K.

episodes.title: Nobu Arrives in Tokyo! NANA's Song
episodes.summary: A routine emerges as the Nanas settle into their life in Tokyo. A makeshift performance foreshadows stages and songs to come…

episodes.title: The Handsome Youth Shin Appears!
episodes.summary: While BLAST searches for a drummer and a bassist, Shouji is tasked with training a newbie at work. Much to his chagrin, her name is Sachiko.

episodes.title: Sachiko, Is This on Purpose?
episodes.summary: An unexpected closure forces Hachi to find a new job, but that's not the only thing she has to worry about. Elsewhere, BLAST may have just found their drummer.

episodes.title: Urgent Approach! Shoji and Sachiko
episodes.summary: As Hachi struggles to pick up the pieces, Shouji faces an important decision. His choice could leave Nana K. shattered.

episodes.title: Sachiko's Tears, Shoji's Determination
episodes.summary: An impromptu trip to a certain restaurant could spell disaster for Hachi.

episodes.title: Family Restaurant of Shambles
episodes.summary: What's the cure for a broken heart? Distraction! Good thing an unexpected acquisition just gave Hachi something to look forward to.

episodes.title: Blast, First Live
episodes.summary: BLAST's first concert is close at hand, and one of Nana O.'s old fans just reappeared out of the blue.

episodes.title: NANA's Love Whereabouts
episodes.summary: Hachi takes an interest in Nana O.'s love life. Good thing she knows exactly who to consult to get all the juicy gossip… or does she?

episodes.title: Trapnest, Live
episodes.summary: Trapnest is entrancing to see live, but Hachi can't help but notice the way Nana O. seems particularly transfixed on the band's guitarist.

episodes.title: Hachi's Prayer, NANA's Thoughts
episodes.summary: Nana O.'s presence at the concert has not gone unnoticed. But what does this encounter bode: a reunion, or just more heartbreak?

episodes.title: NANA's Prize
episodes.summary: Nana and Ren have a conversation about the future. Later, the gang gets together for game night — but they're joined by an unexpected guest.

episodes.title: Sudden Development! Hachi's Fate
episodes.summary: Relationships new and old come to light. Hachi discovers she has a lot in common with Nobu.

episodes.title: Dream of Suite Room
episodes.summary: After an eventful dinner date, Hachi finds herself faced with a difficult decision with far-reaching consequences. Meanwhile, Yasu finds BLAST another opportunity to play!

episodes.title: Wish of July 7th, Hachi's Love
episodes.summary: Trapnest returns from tour, but their homecoming isn't what Hachi dreamed it would be. Later, Takumi's opinion of Hachi causes strife between him, Nobu and Shin.

episodes.title: I Do Not Want to Pass Over to Anybody
episodes.summary: While Nobu wrestles with his feelings for a certain someone, Ren has a surprising proposition for Nana. But those aren't the only relationships getting off the ground…

episodes.title: Hachi's Confused Heart
episodes.summary: A heartfelt confession presents Hachi with a devastating choice.

episodes.title: A Capricious and Selfish Man
episodes.summary: Nana and Ren settle into a temporary living arrangement. Shin compares the different women in his life. Layla and Takumi cross paths in an unexpected place.

episodes.title: The Passing Hachi and NANA
episodes.summary: BLAST's performance is right around the corner, and it promises to be a full house. But when Nana isn't up for celebrating with Hachi, Hachi turns to someone else for comfort.

episodes.title: Hachi's Desired Future
episodes.summary: A meeting is called between (most of) BLAST's members, but what would a meeting be without booze? Hachi and Nobu volunteer to procure the goods!

episodes.title: Hachi and Nobu, Urgent Approach
episodes.summary: Hachi has come to a decision regarding her love life, but will following through on her choice be easier said than done?

episodes.title: The Problem of Expressing Love
episodes.summary: Hachi and Nana have a heart-to-heart about Hachi's feelings for Nobu. Elsewhere, Takumi has an unexpected reaction to Hachi's continued absence.

episodes.title: Breakdown, NANA's Heart
episodes.summary: While Nana starts a new job to make ends meet, Hachi doesn't feel too well at work. The reason behind her illness may change everything about her life in Tokyo — forever.

episodes.title: Hachi's Child, Pregnancy
episodes.summary: Hachi grapples with the discovery of her condition. Takumi makes a declaration that sends Nobu reeling.

episodes.title: Don't Separate the Joined Hands
episodes.summary: Nobu and Nana discuss how he should handle the current situation. Do Layla's red threads bind Nobu and Hachi together, or…?

episodes.title: Hachi's Choice
episodes.summary: Hachi makes up her mind — and, unexpectedly, so does Takumi.

episodes.title: Fireworks Display, Hachi and NANA
episodes.summary: With Nana K and Takumi's wedding two weeks away, both Nana K and Nobu are nervous about seeing each other, but Nana O is determined to bring them together at the fireworks show that the band is attending in disguise.
